item.title: Github Action Locally
item.description:
Nektosact - runners Run GitHub Actions locally nektos/act.

Config

install

Window choco install act-cli

MacOS brew install act

Linux curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nektos/act/master/install.sh | sudo bash

set act image

  • Reference Can’t figure out how to reset image choice. #2219

./.actrc For project specfic settings ~/.actrc For global settings (default location of old versions of act, ~ is your userprofile/home folder) %localappdata%/act/actrc (Windows, Don’t remember 100%ly) /Users/[username]/Library/Application Support/act (macOS)
